# Inglasia Intuitor

> Inglasia Intuitor is an electronic Quality Management System (eQMS) built for pharmaceutical and life-sciences Quality teams.

The platform covers document control, deviations, CAPA, change control, and learning/training management as a single connected system, with workflows aligned to established GxP compliance frameworks.

## Platform

- [Inglasia Intuitor eQMS](https://inglasiaintuitor.com/): Product overview, platform modules, and compliance positioning.
- [Document Control](https://inglasiaintuitor.com/#platform): Controlled document lifecycle, from draft through approval to effective status.
- [Deviations](https://inglasiaintuitor.com/#platform): Deviation submission and review workflow.
- [CAPA](https://inglasiaintuitor.com/#platform): Corrective and Preventive Action lifecycle management.
- [Change Control](https://inglasiaintuitor.com/#platform): Change impact assessment and controlled change workflow.
- [Learning Management](https://inglasiaintuitor.com/#platform): Training status tracking that gates access to other modules' actions.

These five modules are currently presented as sections of the homepage rather than as separate URLs; the link above points to the shared section they live in.

## Compliance

The site references the following GxP/data-integrity frameworks and concepts (see the homepage's compliance and standards sections):

- [21 CFR Part 11](https://inglasiaintuitor.com/#standards): FDA electronic records and electronic signatures.
- [EU GMP Annex 11](https://inglasiaintuitor.com/#standards): EU GMP guideline on computerised systems.
- [GAMP 5](https://inglasiaintuitor.com/#standards): ISPE risk-based approach to computerised system validation.
- [ALCOA+](https://inglasiaintuitor.com/#standards): Data integrity principles (Attributable, Legible, Contemporaneous, Original, Accurate, plus Complete, Consistent, Enduring, Available).
- [ICH Q9](https://inglasiaintuitor.com/#standards): Quality risk management.
- [ICH Q10](https://inglasiaintuitor.com/#standards): Pharmaceutical quality system.
- [Data Integrity](https://inglasiaintuitor.com/#standards): General data integrity principles referenced alongside ALCOA+.

These are referenced as frameworks the platform's workflows are designed around; this file does not claim formal certification, regulatory approval, or endorsement by any authority.
